Text: WHEN the POS sends a completed purchase event, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for the member.
IF a member requests a redemption of fewer than 500 posted points, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the redemption with the reason "below minimum".
Rationale: Minimum redemption in the programme terms.

Text: WHEN the POS requests voucher validation, the loyalty service shall respond within TBD ms at the 95th percentile under year-end peak load.
The loyalty service shall accept purchase events at TBD events per minute without loss during the year-end sale.
Rationale: Last year's peak was about 9,000 purchases per minute (SH-08).

Text: The admin console shall require multi-factor authentication when a support agent logs in.
The loyalty service shall retain points transaction records for 7 years.
The loyalty service shall run on the platform team's Kubernetes platform.
